mutation_semantics: Apply references-stage replacements before dereference; clone every candidate occurrence; apply expanded-stage replacements only at existing expanded fields, then evidence-stage replacements to declared nullable evidence cells. No insertion/coercion/ID-keyed deduplication. Exact post-mutation inventory/ownership in schema-control-contract.md. Invalid requests preserve bounded raw input with parsed request null.

exact_slot_inventory.slot_id_rule: S-{supplied-index}-{quantity} (shared uses S-X); case_id binds uniqueness
exact_slot_inventory.for_known_ineligible: all numerical slots explicit not_applicable with reason malformed_fit/configuration_mismatch etc, not fabricated values
exact_slot_inventory.for_unknown: all unavailable slots unknown/not_evaluated with explicit reason; keep any completed arrays
exact_slot_inventory.all_time_components: retain every row; omitted row is incomplete evidence even if final B is sufficient mathematically

real_worker_inventory.base_candidates: ALL 3 supplied candidates in order [8,2,4], independently return arrays and exact-assess each mode; require selected ID/outcome agreement or stop
real_worker_inventory.working_scope: tau=1 cases only after all base exact assessments and tau gates; hold selected config fixed, preinventory AD/FD branches for each candidate, mark nonselected branches not_applicable, never silently omit slots
real_worker_inventory.per_branch_binding: case+candidate+mode+branch+quantity, actual returned fit producer/config/source; scalar h at base explicit not_applicable; q fixed from base; branch output is fit->apply+scale composition
real_worker_inventory.comparisons: all 10 dtype policies in comparison-policies.json for EACH selected tau1 case, both modes where applicable; all h/adjacent pairs; full forward vs D each mode. Per candidate base forward recursive vs exact D_hat for ALL 3 candidates; forward eager/JIT for ALL 3; base exact bound gates for both modes. Alpha-perturbed branches have no alpha=1/2 rational oracle.
real_worker_inventory.slot_id_rule: {mode}-{supplied-index}-{branch}-{quantity}, case_id plus slot_id is globally unique
real_worker_inventory.AD_composition: After exhaustive base selection, selected-mode ad-base is ONE value_and_grad(objective,argnums=(input,alpha),has_aux=True) composition returning both cotangents and actual fit/output/objective auxiliaries. This records derivatives of fit->apply+dt**(-alpha), with fit independent of input. Preserve ad-base arrays as a separate observation, not borrowed base/eager bytes; authenticated equality with SAME-mode base is a required gate before exact-reference cache reuse. Never run selection inside AD. h is unused at ad-base and explicitly not_applicable. Future implementation may choose equivalent joint differentiation only if same-forward auxiliaries are retained and reviewed.
real_worker_inventory.ad_base_joint_cotangents: input_AD and order_AD come from one selected same-forward joint value_and_grad composition; directional_AD uses fixed actual q

preinventory_rules: Each case required_evidence_slots is exact, including all supplied candidates. All start not_evaluated. No slot is implicitly omitted. Invalid/unsupported cases may stop before arithmetic but keep explicit slot reasons. For tau1 FIT-REAL, AD/FD branches for every candidate are preinventoried; nonselected candidate branches are explicitly not_applicable. Full output is shared and not candidate-attributed. Working comparisons bind actual mode/branch arrays; comparison ID plus case ID is unique. The scalar h and direction slots that are unused (base h, unselected direction) are explicitly not_applicable. Full/scalar shapes are defined by the semantic schema predicate. Reference-level list mutations apply FIRST. Inventories reflect actual post-mutation occurrences; empty means no candidate slots. Candidate index distinguishes duplicate invalid raw occurrences. All unfinished working comparisons and fit identity checks persist in initialized/final index. See schema-control-contract.md.
